description: TypeScript strict configuration enforcing type safety across the project. tsconfig.json enables: strict mode, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, noImplicitOverride, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, verbatimModuleSyntax, and isolatedModules. Target ES2022 with ESNext modules and bundler resolution.
spec:
1. Verify `bun run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) passes with no errors.
2. Verify tsconfig.json has `strict: true`.
3. Verify tsconfig.json has `noUnusedLocals: true` and `noUnusedParameters: true`.
4. Verify tsconfig.json has `verbatimModuleSyntax: true`.
5. Verify no `any` types are used in source code (enforced by ESLint `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any: error`).
title: TypeScript Strict Configuration
notes: Revision 1.1.0 (2026-06-11): tsconfig strictness tightened (noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, verbatimModuleSyntax, et al.); formatTable typed with generics, eliminating any[].
